main_text.p: stratu, item loco de Disciplinâ Ecclesiasticâ, item de Vocatione Pastorum, item de conciliis. Eorundem Censuram Confessionis Remonstrantium cap. 25. Cl. Rivetum in Commentario in Decalogum ad præceptum quintum. Cl. Walæum de Officio ministrorum &c. per totum. Amesii Medullam Theologicam loco de Magistratu. Altstedii Supplementum in Panstrat. Chamierii lib. de jurisdict. Ecclesiæ Milit. capp. 3. 4. &c. item alios recentiores Anglos Theologos, ut L. Cicestrensis tortuīram Torti[?]. Bilsonium de perpetuâ gubernatione Ecclesiæ, & alios. Ut jam Musculum non allegem, qui in hac materiâ circa quædam recedere à communi consensu Doctorum Reformatorum odio disciplinæ Anabaptisticæ videtur, & pastoribus minus tribuere nonnullibi quàm par est; Theologus alioquin insignis & de Ecclesia bene meritus. page.notes: The running head carries "Q. I." at the right, a quaestio mark, which I have not placed in the running head. The page number "10" is printed at the top left. "Torti" is read with doubt; the scan is blurred there. "Panstrat." and "Cicestrensis" are italic and partly blurred. The catchword "gorum" stands at the lower right.
